messages:
olivia: Hey team — I got married in Ireland on 2026-01-15 and just returned. I tried to add my spouse in Workday but marriage cert is in Irish with no apostille yet. I missed the 30-day QLE window because the embassy mail took forever. Can I still add her retroactive to 2026-01-15 and what docs do you need? Also wondering if this changes my tax withholdings.

samir (People Ops): Congrats, Olivia! Short answer: we can evaluate a late dependent add for international marriages. We'll need a certified English translation of the marriage certificate (translator name/contact and date on doc) plus one photo ID for your spouse (passport). If apostille arrives later that's fine; translations usually suffice. Explain the embassy delay on the exception form.

olivia: Great — do you need both original and translation uploaded, or just the translated PDF?

nora (Benefits): Upload both if possible (scan of original and the certified translation). Also include proof of marriage date (wedding venue confirmation or international registrar screenshot) if available. For retro effective date: if we approve the late-add exception we typically set effective date to the date of the marriage (2026-01-15) provided the documentation supports it.

olivia: Any guidance on what to write in the exception form about the embassy delay? Should I include tracking numbers?

samir (People Ops): Yes — include brief timeline: marriage date, date you returned, date you mailed docs, tracking numbers, and when you attempted to submit in Workday. Clear timeline helps approvals for international mailing delays.

hr-bot: Form: /hr/forms/late-dependent-exception.pdf (fillable). Upload docs to Workday under Benefits > Attachments. Link: https://intranet.redwood/hr/forms/late-dependent-exception

lee (Payroll): Payroll note: if Benefits approves retro effective 2026-01-15 we will backdate premium deductions and process any necessary payroll adjustments. We need spouse SSN within 60 days of approval to finalize tax reporting; if SSN is pending, we can provisionally enroll but SSN must be updated when available. Regarding tax withholdings, adding a spouse can affect your marital filing status and exemptions — but payroll doesn't change federal/state tax withholding automatically based on benefits. If you want to update W-4 withholding, submit the W-4 change in Workday or ask payroll to send form.

olivia: She's applying for SSN now — embassy delay again. If SSN comes later, will there be any penalty on my end?

nora (Benefits): No penalties for late-add exceptions approved for valid reasons. If SSN isn't provided within the policy window we may reverse retro adjustments, but we'll coordinate with you. Provide SSN as soon as it's available.

olivia: Uploaded: original_marriage_cert_ireland_2026-01.pdf, translation_marriage_cert_2026-02.pdf, spouse_passport_2026-02.pdf, exception_form_olivia_2026-02.pdf (with tracking numbers).

samir (People Ops): Received. We'll review and target a response within 5 business days. If approved we'll notify Benefits + Payroll to enact retro enrollment and advise on W-4 if you request withholding changes.

olivia: Thanks — appreciate the quick help! :smile:

samir (People Ops): Filing note: keep this thread for SSN follow-up. If tracking shows further delays ping us and we'll flag the exception for expedited review.
